description_en:
This API retrieves the metadata needed to upload a file as a work item attachment. It is the first of three steps:\
1. Call this API to get the upload information.\
2. Use the information in the response to upload the file to Object Storage Service (OSS).\
3. Call the `WorkitemAttachmentCreate` API to associate the uploaded file with the work item.\
\
For step 2, refer to the OSS documentation at https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31926.html. The request must use the `POST` method and be submitted as a form.\
\
\
\
\
description_zh:
获取工作项附件上传的信息接口，这是工作项上传附件中的第一步。整个过程需要完成三步，
第一步，调用该接口获取工作项的上传信息。
第二步，根据该接口的返回信息将文件上传到oss中。
第三步，将文件作为工作项的附件，对应的接口为 WorkitemAttachmentCreate(关联文件为工作项的附件)

第二步上传文件时可以参考oss的文档：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31926.html，
注意请求为POST方法，数据是表单提交的方式
name: GetWorkitemAttachmentCreatemeta

parameters.help_en: The organization ID. You can obtain this ID from the URL in Alibaba Cloud DevOps. Example: `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the work item
parameters.help_zh: 工作项id，同workItemId，工作项唯一标识
parameters.name: workitem_identifier

parameters.help_en: The name of the file to upload
parameters.help_zh: 需要上传的文件完整名称
parameters.name: file_name

If `success` is `false`, this field contains the error code.

If `success` is `true`, this field is empty
errorCode.description_zh:
当success为false，返回业务错误码；
 
当success为true，返回空值。

If `success` is `false`, this field contains the error message.

If `success` is `true`, this field is empty
errorMessage.description_zh:

requestId.description_en: The request ID. A unique value generated for each request, used for troubleshooting
requestId.description_zh: 请求id，每次请求都是唯一值，便于后续排查问题

success.description_zh: true 接口调用成功，false 接口调用失败
